title: imogene + willie x Gibson "The Funk" Tee

long_description.body:
This short-sleeved 7 oz. "vintage midweight" tee features funk-inspired artwork. It was patterned, cut, sewn, and screen-printed here in the USA from American-made fabric. This garment was also washed and preshrunk.



100% cotton
Fits true to size
Wash cold, tumble dry low
